question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Boisterous
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Boisterous"** means noisy, energetic, and cheerful; rowdy. (उद्धत, शोरगुल करनेवाला)

 
 
• **Example:** The children were very boisterous at the birthday party, running around and shouting.
 
 
 
• **"Quiet"** means making little or no noise; silent. (शांत)
 
 
• **Example:** The library was so quiet that you could hear a pin drop.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **"Boisterous"** is **"Quiet"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Noisy** (शोर मचाने वाला): Making or given to making a lot of noise.

 
 
• **Example:** The noisy crowd made it difficult to hear the speaker.
 
 
 
• **Benevolent** (दयालु): Well-meaning and kindly.
 
 
• **Example:** The benevolent gentleman donated a large sum to the orphanage.
 
 
 
• **Buoyant** (उत्साही): Cheerful and optimistic.
 
 
• **Example:** She had a buoyant personality that lifted the spirits of everyone around her.

The correct answer is: **Option 3**.
